description: This file defines the AsyncResultHandle class used for internal testing within the Orleans testing framework. It provides mechanisms to wait for certain conditions asynchronously with timeout support.

classes.name: AsyncResultHandle
classes.description: A class for managing asynchronous result handling with support for waiting on flags with timeout.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the result handle, clearing exceptions and results, and resetting flags.

methods.name: WaitForFinished
methods.description: Asynchronously waits until the 'done' flag is true or the timeout expires.

methods.name: WaitForContinue
methods.description: Asynchronously waits until the 'continueFlag' is true or the timeout expires.

methods.name: WaitFor
methods.description: Generic method that waits asynchronously until a specified condition (checkFlag) is true or the timeout expires.
